title: Dependence of the nonlinear Schr{ö}dinger flow upon the nonlinearity
summary: We consider the defocusing nonlinear Schr{ö}dinger equation in the energy-subcritical case, and investigate the dependence of the solution upon the power of the nonlinearity. Special attention is paid to the global in time description. The main three aspects addressed, in the decreasing order of difficulty, are the limit when the total power tends to one, along with the connection with the logarithmic Schr{ö}dinger equation, the description when long range effects may be present, and the continuity of the scattering operator in the short range case.
